Hi Elena — great to hear. Wed 12/23 at 10:30 PST works on our side. I've penciled that in for 60 minutes.

Attaching a prep checklist (redwood_sig_prep_checklist.xlsx) that lists the typical artifacts we request and owners for each item. For your three asks:
- Artifacts: SOC 2 report (if available), CAIQ answers, architecture diagram, sample logs, access control matrix, and policy artifacts. The checklist maps owners to items.
- Logs: preferred ingestion is an S3 presigned URL (we can provide), but we also support secure file upload to our intake portal. We'll include instructions in the checklist.
- KMS: we support customer-managed keys (KMS/HSM) and can provide the KMS integration doc during the call.

Agenda for the call (60m):
1) Introductions + scope (10m)
2) Questionnaire approach and ownership (15m)
3) Evidence handoff mechanics (S3/upload) and sample log format (15m)
4) Action items + next steps (20m)

If you want to change the time or extend to 75 minutes to run deeper on logs, let me know.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Security & Compliance Programs
Redwood Inference
